capabilities: Browse a sidebar folder tree with keyboard or mouse
Preview the selected note, canvas, or base in a reused content tab
Create, rename, and drag-and-drop notes, folders, canvases, and bases
Sort the tree by name, modified, or created time and auto-reveal the active file
Open File Explorer context menus or a native fallback on right-click
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not the Quick Switcher and does not replace the built-in File Explorer or provide search; it adds a separate sidebar tree view.
extras: Desktop only; installed manually by copying three files into the vault (no community-store install). Uses private Obsidian APIs that may break between versions, and the README states the plugin has not been tested inside Obsidian, with manual checks and a node test script instead. GitHub release assets are attested for provenance, which the README notes is not a security audit.
problem: Browsing folders and previewing notes in Obsidian normally requires leaving the sidebar or opening a new tab for each file, and the built-in File Explorer cannot be operated entirely from the keyboard while it stays focused.
summary: Desktop sidebar plugin that shows a keyboard- and mouse-driven folder tree and previews the selected note, canvas, or base in one reusable content tab.
